description: Repaired whimsical animal deck with many backs.

composition.count_basis: Authored per-card records and visual/XML inspection; graphic count includes backs and extras, not the game deck size.

source_selection.record_type: Historical import selection; not a regeneration instruction or verified license
source_selection.author_override: Brian Huisman / GreyWyvern; SVG/PySol packaging by AntumDeluge

license_audit.notes: AntumDeluge port has a CC0 license file; original Brian Huisman/GreyWyvern source license not independently verified.
license_audit.attribution_requirements: NOT VERIFIED for the complete set: resolve the original license version/notice and per-graphic attribution requirements before publication; preserve existing source credits.

curation.reason: Repaired whimsical animal deck with many backs; pixel-derived vector rectangles are an intentional retro style, not grounds for deletion. Original GreyWyvern rights chain not verified.
repairs: Replace unsupported symbol/nested SVG wrappers with explicit viewBox transforms and addressable groups.
Add the existing application card IDs while retaining original artwork/source IDs; optional missing graphics use the unchanged default deck.
Map the monochrome numbered joker to joker_black and the colored joker to joker_red, retaining original numbered IDs.

runtime.notes: Bundled theme discovery reads the curated cards.json catalog, preserving noncontiguous numeric IDs. Default and optional fallback graphics remain cards_0.svg. Selection does not approve redistribution.
